name: php
description: Intelephense 1.18.5 uses nested workspace settings under intelephense. diagnostics.enable is boolean; diagnostics.undefinedVariables is the string enum on/local/off, NOT boolean. The installed parser rejects boolean and retains its default. Configure {"intelephense":{"diagnostics":{"enable":true,"undefinedVariables":"on"}}}. Indexing must finish before judging diagnostics; project stubs and include paths affect results.
